source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1030 saves focusout targets unless the manager contains them, then restores that element on an accepted primary CTA click or when hiding the notification. The native container has tabindex="0", so it can receive focus without becoming the restoration target. The test covers no focus theft on open, restoration after close and moving focus inside the shadow-tree container before closing. This is an actual focus contract; pointer and programmatic-focus tests do not prove every keyboard or assistive-technology interaction.
title: Restore notification focus to the last element outside the notification
